title: decree retry --format json
description: What `decree retry --format json` prints on stdout: the run made pending and the state the next `decree process` continues it in. On failure nothing is printed on stdout; the error goes to stderr and the exit code is 1. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

state.description: The atomic state the run is pending in: `--state`, or the default (docs/reference/cli.md).
